$comment: Hard npm-tarball budgets. Required public docs, editor/CEM data, declarations, runtime, compatibility metadata, and generated references remain shipped. Re-measured on 2026-09-18 on the current 18.2.0 source tree with the pending export-button, heatmap, and lightbox changes: 8,351,628 packed bytes, 33,935,107 unpacked bytes, 3,551 files. Measure on the release commit, never before the version bump -- the bump adds the release's CHANGELOG section (a shipped file) and the new version/release history in package-metadata.ts, so a pre-bump measurement is always short. The approved exception still fails closed above this exact reviewed ceiling.

baselineExceptionReview.reason: Re-measured ON the 18.2.0 release commit, per this file's own rule that a pre-bump measurement always under-counts: `changeset version` writes the release's CHANGELOG section (a shipped file) and the new version and release history in package-metadata.ts. The prior ceiling of 8,349,035 was set on the 18.0.0 release commit; 18.2.0 measured 8,351,628, over by 2,593 bytes (0.03%). The growth is lr-map's legendControlRole (the property, its checkbox render branch, stories and the regenerated manifest/editor-data/llms surfaces) plus the --lr-icon-button-size-scope precedence fix and its regression test. Drift headroom is unchanged at 34,000 packed bytes (0.41%); unpacked and fileCount both stayed within their existing reviewed ceilings and are not re-baselined here.
